description.value: Bubble World is a bubble tea café situated in a strip-mall unit in the Walnut Grove neighbourhood of Langley, BC. Specialising in bubble tea drinks, it offers a sweet, cold-drink stop for cyclists passing through this busy suburban corridor. The café is tagged in OSM as cuisine=bubble_tea, suggesting a focused menu centred on milk teas and fruit teas.
